symptom: Cancelling a native ScrollArea thumb drag or losing its capture left selection disabled and allowed later pointer motion to keep scrolling; unmount and viewport replacement also retained the drag resources. Treating callback-ref null as removal then aborted healthy drags on ordinary parent renders or caller-ref changes.
rule: Keep the acquired pointer, capture target and viewport together. Retire once before releasing capture on matching end, cancellation, loss or actual node replacement/removal; callback-ref reassignment of the same connected node must preserve the drag. Fence deferred removal checks to the acquired drag and ref notification, restore exact styles and reject late or foreign-pointer events without synthesizing pointerup.
